name: The Room Addition Planning Timeline: What to Expect
description: The Room Addition Planning Timeline: What to Expect

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Planning a room addition for your home in areas like Aurora or Castle Rock can feel like a huge undertaking, but breaking it down into phases helps a ton. Here’s a typical timeline of what you can expect when working with us. Phase 1 is all about *defining the why*. We'll sit down and clarify the exact reason for the addition, who will use it, and what functions it absolutely must serve. This is where we talk about your ideal timeframe and any fixed deadlines. Phase 2 involves *site and household needs review*. We'll look at your property, your existing home's layout, and how the addition will integrate. This is also where we discuss current and future household needs, like mobility or family size changes. Phase 3 is *scope and budget prioritization*. Here, we define the exact scope of the project, setting a realistic budget and deciding what features are essential versus what's optional. Getting clear on this early is crucial. Phase 4 focuses on *design and coordination*. This is where design development happens, and we coordinate with any necessary subcontractors. Remember, things like permits and approvals can sometimes add time, so getting an early start on scheduling is always a good idea. This phased approach helps ensure that your room addition is well-planned, fits your needs, and avoids common pitfalls. If you're feeling lost in the details, or if your addition requires complex integration with your existing home, reaching out to a professional general contractor can really streamline the entire process.
